description.value: Deer One Hot Pot is a Chinese hot pot restaurant in Richmond, part of the Deer Garden Signatures brand, where diners choose from an extensive range of soup bases — including Sichuan spicy, Malay Laksa, Thai Tom Yum, and vegan mushroom — then cook premium meats, seafood, and vegetables at the table. The restaurant is located in a commercial complex with two hours of free indoor parking. It offers a warm sit-down experience suited for a longer meal stop on a cycling tour of the Richmond area.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 28m; rack at 39m; rack at 45m; rack at 50m; rack at 58m; rack at 68m; rack at 80m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at deeronehotpot.com confirms the OSM address (120 - 8119 Park Road, Richmond BC), phone (604.821.6884), and that the business is active (copyright 2025, full menu content). The site repeatedly advertises '2 HOURS FREE INDOOR PARKING' which refers to vehicle parking, not bike-specific infrastructure — no bike rack or cyclist amenities are mentioned. The soup menu explicitly lists 'Mixed Mushroom Soup (Vegan)', confirming at least one vegan option.
concerns: Website page titles read 'Deer One Hop Pot_NEW' — appears to be a Wix site-builder artifact; the body content consistently uses 'DEER ONE HOT POT', which is a minor capitalisation/spacing variant of the OSM name 'Deer One Hotpot'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant confirmed by a current website with full menu content, matching address, and 2025 copyright. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial hot meal in Richmond.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website soup menu explicitly lists 'Mixed Mushroom Soup (Vegan)' as an available soup base
